scientific_integrity: The exact optimum follows from a symbolic lower-bound proof and an explicit matching word, supplemented by independent finite breadth-first search; no independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-letter directed generator a:i→i+1 and the single unitary merge b:0→h are covered. Other generator sets or weighted costs may alter shortest lengths. Literature overlap outside searched and inspected texts remains possible.
title: Exact reset thresholds for cyclic automata with a single jump merge
